frames.title: Lesson 186 · stop doing / stop to do — form

body: **Foco:** stop doing / stop to do — forma.
**Texto do dia:** texto acadêmico e resumo.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (B2):** eu consigo distinguir stop doing (parar de fazer) e stop to do (parar para fazer) num texto acadêmico sobre hábitos.

body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Habit Formation: When to Stop
paras: Researchers found that people who **stop checking** their phones after dinner sleep better. In another study, participants who **stopped to take** a short walk every hour concentrated more. The distinction matters: to **stop doing** something is to end a habit; to **stop to do** something is to pause in order to act.
Participants **couldn’t stop thinking** about the results, so the team **stopped to reconsider** the design.

items.q: People who stop checking phones after dinner sleep better.
Stopping to take a walk means ending the habit of walking.
The team stopped to reconsider the design.

head: Estrutura
Sentido
rows: parar para fazer: **stop to take** a walk

blocks.body: **stop + -ing** = **interromper a ação**. **stop + to + verbo** = **interromper algo para fazer outra coisa**. Compare: *He stopped smoking* × *He stopped to smoke*.

items.s: People who stop ___ their phones sleep better. (check, -ing)
They stopped ___ take a short walk. (to)
The team stopped to ___ the design. (reconsider)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: So stop to take a walk means…
items.pt: Então “stop to take a walk” significa…?

body: **Old habits die hard.** — Velhos hábitos custam a morrer.
**Get into the habit.** — Pegar o hábito.
**So “stop to take a walk” means…?** — Então “stop to take a walk” significa…?
**What is the difference between “stop checking” and “stop to check”?** — Qual a diferença entre “stop checking” e “stop to check”?
**You pause what you’re doing in order to walk.** — Você pausa o que faz para caminhar.

blocks.title: Listening lab
lines: What is the difference between “stop checking” and “stop to check”?
Qual a diferença entre “stop checking” e “stop to check”?
“Stop checking” ends the habit; “stop to check” means pause in order to check.
“Stop checking” encerra o hábito; “stop to check” é parar para checar.
So “stop to take a walk” means…?
Então “stop to take a walk” significa…?
You pause what you’re doing in order to walk.
Você pausa o que faz para caminhar.

blocks.title: Pronúncia: Entonação de contraste, surpresa, dúvida

items.label: Entonação de contraste, surpresa, dúvida
items.note: Tom desce-sobe para contraste e surpresa; sobe para dúvida: Really? ↗ I said BLUE, not green.

blocks.task: Write 5 sentences contrasting stop doing and stop to do.
blocks.model: He stopped smoking last year. He stopped to smoke outside the café. I stopped checking my phone at night. I stopped to check a message. We can’t stop laughing.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
